rounds.name: Initial Build
rounds.goal:
Round 1 — Initial Build. In scoreboard.py, render(entries) takes dicts {lane, passed, n} and returns ...
LaneHeld-out
with one LANEPASSED/N per entry in input order. Add a module-level SAMPLE list of at least two entries. render returns one well-formed XHTML element (parseable by xml.etree.ElementTree.fromstring). preview() returns render of the module's SAMPLE. Keep every earlier round's behaviour.

heldout.code:
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

import pytest

import scoreboard


def test_r1_compositional():
    e = ET.fromstring(scoreboard.render([{'lane': 'evoforge', 'passed': 3, 'n': 3}, {'lane': 'single', 'passed': 1, 'n': 3}]))
    assert e.tag == 'table' and e.get('class') == 'scoreboard'
    assert [r.get('data-lane') for r in e.find('tbody').findall('tr')] == ['evoforge', 'single']
    assert [r.findall('td')[1].text for r in e.find('tbody').findall('tr')] == ['3/3', '1/3']

def test_r1_negative():

    assert [th.text for th in e.find('thead').iter('th')][:2] == ['Lane', 'Held-out']

def test_r1_boundary():

rounds.name: Feature Growth
rounds.goal: Round 2 — Feature Growth. Add a third column Cost whose cell shows cost_cents as dollars with two decimals ("$0.20" for 20; "n/a" when an entry has no cost_cents). Order rows by pass rate passed/n, highest first (n == 0 counts as 0), keeping input order for ties. After tbody add LANE leads naming the first row's lane, or "No runs" when there are no entries. An entry with n < 0, passed < 0 or passed > n raises ValueError. render returns one well-formed XHTML element (parseable by xml.etree.ElementTree.fromstring). preview() returns render of the module's SAMPLE. Keep every earlier round's behaviour.

rounds.name: UX Refinement
rounds.goal: Round 3 — UX Refinement. Add <caption>Held-out scoreboard</caption> as the table's first child and scope="col" on every header cell. The first (leading) row gets class="leader" (no other row has a class). The score cell gets title="P of N held-out tests passed" and data-rate="R" with R = round(100 * P / N), 0 when N is 0. render returns one well-formed XHTML element (parseable by xml.etree.ElementTree.fromstring). preview() returns render of the module's SAMPLE. Keep every earlier round's behaviour.

rounds.name: Optimization
rounds.goal: Round 4 — Robustness. HTML-escape lane names in text and attributes. When a lane appears more than once keep only the entry with the most passed tests (the first one on ties), in the lane's first position. Show at most 8 rows, then +K more inside tbody. Dollar amounts of $1,000 or more use thousands separators ("$1,234.56"). render returns one well-formed XHTML element (parseable by xml.etree.ElementTree.fromstring). preview() returns render of the module's SAMPLE. Keep every earlier round's behaviour.
